definitions.explanation: A flowering plant with sword-shaped leaves and showy purple, blue, or white flowers. Associated with late spring and early summer.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{美|うつく}しい{菖蒲|あやめ}が{咲|さ}いています。
examples.english: Beautiful irises are blooming in the garden.

examples.japanese: {菖蒲|あやめ}は{五月|ごがつ}の{花|はな}です。
「{いずれ菖蒲|あやめ}か{杜若|かきつばた}」という{言葉|ことば}があります。
examples.english: There's a saying "Whether iris or rabbitear iris" (meaning hard to distinguish between beauties).

notes:
{菖蒲|あやめ} refers to iris flowers.

Note: The same kanji can be read as しょうぶ for a different plant (sweet flag/calamus), used in {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく} (Boys' Day) baths.

Similar flowers often confused:
- {菖蒲|あやめ} (iris) - grows in dry land
- {杜若|かきつばた} (rabbitear iris) - grows in shallow water
- {花菖蒲|はなしょうぶ} (Japanese iris) - grows in wet areas

Idiom: 「{いずれ菖蒲|あやめ}か{杜若|かきつばた}」- both are so beautiful it's hard to choose (used for comparing equally attractive things/people)

Season: Late spring to early summer (May-June)
